Cancellation Refunds.label: Enable Cancellation Refunds
Cancellation Refunds.description: Refunds the unused share of the recorded state payment when you cancel an eligible unfinished ship, station, facility or troop order. Turning this off stops the extra refund on future cancellations. Takes effect on the next game launch.

Colony Event Display Fix.label: Enable Colony Event Display Fix
Colony Event Display Fix.description: Refreshes grouped colony-event tooltips when the contributing colonies change. For Breeding Worlds, shows each contribution and the empire-wide total. The underlying bonuses are calculated by the game. Takes effect on the next game launch.

Colony Support Rules.label: Enable Colony Support Rules
Colony Support Rules.description: Residents under Exterminate generate no colony production or taxable income and incur 20% of their usual support share. Turning this off restores the game's normal income and support calculation. Takes effect on the next game launch.

Deep Space Stability and Refuel.label: Enable Deep Space Stability and Refuel
Deep Space Stability and Refuel.description: Stabilizes the position of fleets holding in deep space and enables the two optional manual tanker-refuelling commands below. Turning this off also disables those commands and keeps your two choices for later. Takes effect on the next game launch.

Deep Space Stability and Refuel.label: Keep gathering while refuelling
Deep Space Stability and Refuel.description: For a manual player fleet, Move then Refuel from Fuel Tankers keeps the chosen destination. Mobile ships continue at their normal available speed; tankers serve nearby fleet ships first. Stop or a new order cancels it. Requires Positronic Matrix to remember the destination across saves. Off preserves the game's normal refuelling behaviour.

Deep Space Stability and Refuel.label: Gather and refuel here
Deep Space Stability and Refuel.description: Adds a manual fleet order at map coordinates. Shift queues the rendezvous. Requires Positronic Matrix and a fleet tanker.

Freight Visibility.label: Enable Freight Visibility
Freight Visibility.description: Adds cargo aboard freighters, planned pickups and foreign carriers to resource tooltips. This changes the freight information shown. Delivery orders continue to follow their usual rules. Takes effect on the next game launch.

HyperDeny on Move.label: Enable HyperDeny on Move
HyperDeny on Move.description: Allows a player ship following a manual Move order to use HyperDeny against enemies at war. Turning this off restores normal HyperDeny behaviour during movement. Takes effect on the next game launch.

Inherited Ship Retirement.label: Enable Inherited Ship Retirement
Inherited Ship Retirement.description: After the conquest of an empire's last colony, eligible inherited mobile ships follow the receiving empire's Never enlist and Disassemble at Base policy. Civilian and military ships use their respective policies. Takes effect on the next game launch.

Racial Research Unlock.label: Enable Racial Research Unlock
Racial Research Unlock.description: Qualifies a race when at least 3 billion of its residents live on your empire's colonies. Its eligible racial technologies become available when their normal prerequisites are met. Turning this off stops this extra access. Research already completed stays completed. Takes effect on the next game launch.

Resource Intelligence.label: Enable Resource Intelligence
Resource Intelligence.description: Adds Buy resource intelligence in diplomacy. An empire or pirate faction can quote a price for a deposit known to the seller and undiscovered by your empire. Turning this off removes the purchase option. Takes effect on the next game launch.

Retirement Research Report.label: Enable Retirement Research Report
Retirement Research Report.description: Shows every research boost the game awards when your ship is disassembled at a base, including racial rewards. Lists the actual gain for each technology. This is a report only. Rewards, their amounts and their chances are unchanged. Takes effect on the next game launch.

Camera.label: Camera preset
Camera.description: Apply Galaxy 3x / System 2x to change only the two zoom speeds. Other choices stay as set. In the launcher the preset is applied once at game start. In Esc > Settings it is applied when you press Apply.

Camera.label: System zoom speed
Camera.description: Distance per wheel notch or Page Up / Page Down step in a system or local view. If one notch goes past the ship or planet you wanted to inspect, lower this first. Game follows the game's Zoom Speed option. 1x is factory speed, 2x to 4x scale it.

Camera.label: Galaxy zoom speed
Camera.description: Distance per wheel notch or Page Up / Page Down step on the galaxy map. Raise it to cross more of the map per step. Game follows the game's Zoom Speed option. 1x is factory speed. This setting is independent of system zoom.

Camera.label: Show Me view
Camera.description: View opened by Show Me on a message. Keep current zoom centers at your current scale. System Map opens a known system and centers deep-space ships on the galaxy map. Galaxy Map shows the wider area. Game default uses the normal game focus.

Camera.label: Ship focus view
Camera.description: View used when focusing a ship or fleet leader from a list or a selected hotkey. Keep current zoom preserves your scale. System Map opens the system or uses the galaxy map in deep space. Galaxy Map gives a wider view. Game default uses the normal close-up.

Camera.label: Wheel acceleration
Camera.description: Total speed ceiling for a burst of wheel notches in the same direction. Off uses base speed. A 2x ceiling has no effect on a 3x or 4x base. A pause, reversal or map change resets the burst.

Camera.label: Wheel acceleration ramp
Camera.description: How quickly repeated notches reach the acceleration ceiling. Gentle builds slowly, Standard at a medium rate, Fast most quickly. Only affects maps whose base speed is below the enabled ceiling.

Camera.label: Wheel zoom smoothing
Camera.description: Off moves immediately. Short eases each step over about 120 ms. Soft uses the chosen duration. Inertia adds extra travel after fast scrolling where the view allows it. Lower the map speed if one notch covers too much distance.

Camera.label: Wheel smoothing duration
Camera.description: Time to settle after wheel input in Soft and Inertia modes. 220 ms feels more immediate. 320 and 450 ms spread the movement over longer. Short uses a fixed 120 ms.

Camera.label: Wheel inertia coast
Camera.description: Extra travel after a quick series in Inertia mode, as a percentage of the last step. 0% removes the tail. One isolated notch adds no tail. Inward zoom on the system map also omits the extra travel.

Salvage and Refit.label: Enable Salvage and Refit
Salvage and Refit.description: Adds a player order to study unfamiliar equipment and refit a ship or station to a compatible design. A constructor attends stations. Entire stations can also be dismantled. Enabled after restarting the game.
